newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bonds seen well bid next week.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bonds seen well bid next week.

text.p: Belgian bonds, which closed higher on Friday after a lower start, are expected to be well-bid next week.
Several dealers said the there was still a lot of interest in bonds. "Buyers abound," one said.
He added that the market was not ready for a change in the upward trend which started three months ago.
Dealers expect little volume at the monthly OLO auction on Monday, as the Treasury's funding needs are traditionally low towards the end of the year.
OLO futures ended 20 bp higher at 120.37.
The 2006 benchmark yield ended at 5.97 percent, well below the six percent threshold.
"I think the six percent will hold, maybe until the end of the year," on Luxembourg-based dealer said.
He and other dealers said that worries about the political situation were easing, as it began to appear that sex allegations against Deputy Prime Minister Elio di Rupo were not well-founded.
